description.en: Five commands that work with no arguments: review and fix, behavior-preserving simplification, privacy scrubbing, a caption loop with a ledger, and a PUA protocol. Each runs in the current session by default (add sub for an isolated agent) and writes by default (add report for a report only).
description.zh: 五条命令，空输入即可用：审查并修复、行为不变的精炼、隐私清理、带台账的 caption 循环，以及 PUA 协议。默认在当前会话执行（加 sub 改用独立 agent），默认直接改（加 report 只出报告）。
